name: Escape Simulator: Spy DLC
summary:
Inspired by the golden age of spy films, this DLC drops you into a world of covert operations, hidden gadgets, and daring escapes. Work alone or with your team to unravel codes, outsmart villains, and foil sinister plots in four all-new escape rooms:

Agency HQ – Earn your clearance and prove you’ve got what it takes.

Quartermaster’s Workshop – Test out ingenious gadgets before heading into the field.

The Villain’s Yacht – Mingle with high society while uncovering dangerous secrets.
